name: Scroll-Locked Video Hero
rationale: Clean-room implementation from component-specs.md §9 prose only; no 21st.dev source was fetched or read.

trackHeight.description: CSS height of the scroll track the hero pins through.

source.description: Which child media element to scrub; auto picks the first video, else the first canvas.

smoothing.description: Lerp fraction applied per animation frame toward the scroll-driven target.

overlayOut.description: Fraction of the track over which the headline overlay fades and lifts in.

canvasScene.description: Built-in procedural frame renderer used when no media element is supplied.

poster.description: Solid background colour behind the canvas scene and shown while media is idle.

a11y: The overlay is real text in DOM order, not painted into the media.
The media (video or built-in canvas) is decorative: aria-hidden and stripped of controls; supply an aria-label on your own <video> for meaningful content instead.
The overlay sits on a scrim/text-shadow for at least 4.5:1 contrast against the media.
Nothing traps scroll or keyboard focus; the sticky stage releases normally once the track ends.
prefers-reduced-motion removes the pin and scrub entirely: the media holds one frame and the overlay is fully visible with no fade or lift.
